    density = air_density * (1 - h / 100000)  # Assuming air density decreases linearly with height

    dt = 0.1  # time step in seconds
    t = 0
    h = 0
    v = 0
    mass = total_mass
    fuel_burned = 0
    mass_flow = mass_flow_rate(fuel_mass, burn_time)

        fuel_burned += mass_flow * dt
        g = gravity(h)
        air_force = air_resistance(v, h)
